name: ExecuteAuthoritativeCommand
guards: required audit payload validates before persistence
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; same committed id/type/hash returns prior result, mismatch is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; valid semantic no-change commits only its receipt
receipt_order: open keyed/verified connection -> BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> replay check -> current-state revalidation/no-change decision -> insert one receipt -> owner/participant writes -> lifecycle/evidence -> registered owner audit + result refs -> COMMIT
mutations: exact owning-domain rows/evidence/audit rows inside same UnitOfWork
revision_effects: owning contract controls revisions; failed/no-change command changes no domain revision
audit_action: exact owning packet registered action for material mutation; none for accepted semantic NO_CHANGE
post_commit_work: only owning command explicitly registered post-commit work; never hidden inside Foundation boundary
